verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς οἶκόν τινος τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν Φαρισαίων σαββάτῳ φαγεῖν ἄρτον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦσαν παρατηρούμενοι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō elthein auton eis oikon tinos tōn archontōn tōn Pharisaiōn sabbatō phagein arton kai autoi ēsan paratēroumenoi auton
verses.literal: One Sabbath Jesus went to eat . . . in the home of a leading Pharisee and those in attendance were watching Him closely . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jesus entrado um sábado na casa de um dos chefes dos fariseus para comer, eles o estavam observando.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπός τις ἦν ὑδρωπικὸς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai idou anthrōpos tis ēn hydrōpikos emprosthen autou
verses.literal: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy
verses.literalPt: Achava-se diante dele um homem hidrópico.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς νομικοὺς καὶ Φαρισαίους λέγων Ἔξεστιν τῷ σαββάτῳ θεραπεῦσαι ἢ οὔ
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen pros tous nomikous kai Pharisaious legōn Exestin tō sabbatō therapeusai ē ou
verses.literal: So Jesus asked . . . . . . the experts in the law and the Pharisees Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not
verses.literalPt: Jesus, dirigindo-se aos doutores da lei e aos fariseus, perguntou: É lícito ou não curar no sábado?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἡσύχασαν Καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος ἰάσατο αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέλυσεν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de hēsychasan Kai epilabomenos iasato auton kai apelysen
verses.literal: But they remained silent Then Jesus took hold of the man healed him and sent him on his way
verses.literalPt: Mas eles ficaram calados. Então, pegando no homem, curou-o e despediu-o.

verses.original: καὶ πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἶπεν Τίνος ὑμῶν υἱὸς ἢ βοῦς εἰς φρέαρ πεσεῖται καὶ οὐκ εὐθέως ἀνασπάσει αὐτὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου
verses.transliteration: kai pros autous eipen Tinos hymōn huios ē bous eis phrear peseitai kai ouk eutheōs anaspasei auton en hēmera tou sabbatou
verses.literal: And He asked them Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois, lhes perguntou: Qual de vós, se um filho ou um boi cair num poço, não o tirará logo, mesmo em dia de sábado?

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν ἀνταποκριθῆναι πρὸς ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk ischysan antapokrithēnai pros tauta
verses.literal: And they were unable to answer these questions
verses.literalPt: A isso não puderam responder.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς κεκλημένους παραβολήν ἐπέχων πῶς τὰς πρωτοκλισίας ἐξελέγοντο λέγων πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Elegen de pros tous keklēmenous parabolēn epechōn pōs tas prōtoklisias exelegonto legōn pros autous
verses.literal: When Jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor He told . . . . . . . . . them a parable
verses.literalPt: Ao notar como os convidados escolhiam os primeiros lugares, propôs-lhes esta parábola:

verses.original: Ὅταν κληθῇς ὑπό τινος εἰς γάμους μὴ κατακλιθῇς εἰς τὴν πρωτοκλισίαν μή‿ ποτε ἐντιμότερός σου ᾖ κεκλημένος ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan klēthēs hypo tinos eis gamous mē kataklithēs eis tēn prōtoklisian mē pote entimoteros sou ē keklēmenos hyp’ autou
verses.literal: When you are invited . . . . . . to a wedding banquet do not sit in the place of honor in case . . . someone more distinguished than you has been invited
verses.literalPt: Quando fores por alguém convidado para um casamento, não te sentes no primeiro lugar; para não suceder que seja por ele convidada uma pessoa mais considerada do que tu, e,

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ σὲ καὶ αὐτὸν καλέσας ἐρεῖ σοι Δὸς τούτῳ τόπον καὶ τότε ἄρξῃ μετὰ αἰσχύνης τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον κατέχειν
verses.transliteration: kai elthōn ho se kai auton kalesas erei soi Dos toutō topon kai tote arxē meta aischynēs ton eschaton topon katechein
verses.literal: Then the host who invited both of you . . . . . . will come and tell you Give this man your seat And in humiliation you will have to take the last place
verses.literalPt: vindo o que te convidou a ti e a ele, te diga: Dá o lugar a este. Então, irás, envergonhado, ocupar o último lugar.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ὅταν κληθῇς πορευθεὶς ἀνάπεσε εἰς τὸν ἔσχατον τόπον ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ κεκληκώς σε ἐρεῖ σοι Φίλε προσανάβηθι ἀνώτερον τότε ἔσται σοι δόξα ἐνώπιον πάντων τῶν συνανακειμένων σοι
verses.transliteration: All’ hotan klēthēs poreutheis anapese eis ton eschaton topon hina hotan elthē ho keklēkōs se erei soi Phile prosanabēthi anōteron tote estai soi doxa enōpion pantōn tōn synanakeimenōn soi
verses.literal: But when you are invited go and sit in the last place so that - your host . . . will come and tell you Friend move up to a better place Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you
verses.literalPt: Pelo contrário quando fores convidado, vai tomar o último lugar; para que, quando vier o que te convidou, te diga: Amigo, senta-te mais para cima. Então, isto será para ti uma honra diante de todos os mais convivas.

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὑψῶν ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται καὶ ὁ ταπεινῶν ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: hoti pas ho hypsōn heauton tapeinōthēsetai kai ho tapeinōn heauton hypsōthēsetai
verses.literal: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled and the one who humbles himself will be exalted
verses.literalPt: Pois todo o que se exalta será humilhado; mas todo o que se humilha será exaltado.

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τῷ κεκληκότι αὐτόν Ὅταν ποιῇς ἄριστον ἢ δεῖπνον μὴ φώνει τοὺς φίλους σου μηδὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου μηδὲ τοὺς συγγενεῖς σου μηδὲ γείτονας πλουσίους μή‿ ποτε καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀντικαλέσωσίν σε καὶ γένηται ἀνταπόδομά σοι
verses.transliteration: Elegen de kai tō keklēkoti auton Hotan poiēs ariston ē deipnon mē phōnei tous philous sou mēde tous adelphous sou mēde tous syngeneis sou mēde geitonas plousious mē pote kai autoi antikalesōsin se kai genētai antapodoma soi
verses.literal: Then . . . Jesus said to the man who had invited Him When you host a dinner or a banquet do not invite your friends or - brothers or - relatives or rich neighbors Otherwise . . . they may invite you in return and you will be repaid
verses.literalPt: Disse também ao que o havia convidado: Quando deres algum almoço ou ceia, não convides nem teus amigos, nem teus irmãos, nem teus parentes, nem os vizinhos ricos; para não suceder que eles, por sua vez, te convidem, e sejas recompensado.

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὅταν δοχὴν ποιῇς κάλει πτωχούς ἀναπείρους χωλούς τυφλούς
verses.transliteration: all’ hotan dochēn poiēs kalei ptōchous anapeirous chōlous typhlous
verses.literal: But when you host a banquet invite the poor the crippled the lame and the blind
verses.literalPt: Pelo contrário, quando deres um festim, convida os pobres, os aleijados, os coxos e os cegos;

verses.original: καὶ μακάριος ἔσῃ ὅτι οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἀνταποδοῦναί σοι ἀνταποδοθήσεται γάρ σοι ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῶν δικαίων
verses.transliteration: kai makarios esē hoti ouk echousin antapodounai soi antapodothēsetai gar soi en tē anastasei tōn dikaiōn
verses.literal: and you will be blessed Since they cannot repay you you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous
verses.literalPt: e serás bem-aventurado, por não terem eles com que te recompensar, pois serás recompensado na ressurreição dos justos.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δέ τις τῶν συνανακειμένων ταῦτα εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μακάριος ὅστις φάγεται ἄρτον ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Akousas de tis tōn synanakeimenōn tauta eipen autō Makarios hostis phagetai arton en tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: When one of those reclining with Him heard this he said to Jesus Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast . . . in the kingdom of God
verses.literalPt: Ao ouvir essas palavras, disse-lhe um dos convivas: Bem-aventurado aquele que comer pão no reino de Deus!

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἄνθρωπός τις ἐποίει δεῖπνον μέγα καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πολλούς
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autō Anthrōpos tis epoiei deipnon mega kai ekalesen pollous
verses.literal: But Jesus replied A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus disse-lhe: Um homem deu uma grande ceia e convidou a muitos;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ δείπνου εἰπεῖν τοῖς κεκλημένοις Ἔρχεσθε ὅτι ἤδη ἕτοιμά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen ton doulon autou tē hōra tou deipnou eipein tois keklēmenois Erchesthe hoti ēdē hetoima estin
verses.literal: When it was time for the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited Come for everything is now ready
verses.literalPt: e, à hora da ceia, enviou o seu servo para dizer aos convidados: Vinde, porque tudo já está preparado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀπὸ μιᾶς πάντες παραιτεῖσθαι ὁ πρῶτος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀγρὸν ἠγόρασα καὶ ἔχω ἀνάγκην ἐξελθὼν ἰδεῖν αὐτόν ἐρωτῶ σε ἔχε με παρῃτημένον
verses.transliteration: Kai ērxanto apo mias pantes paraiteisthai ho prōtos eipen autō Agron ēgorasa kai echō anankēn exelthōn idein auton erōtō se eche me parētēmenon
verses.literal: But one after another they all began to make excuses The first one said I have bought a field and I need to go see it Please . . . excuse me
verses.literalPt: Começaram todos, à uma, a escusar-se. Comprei um campo, disse um, e preciso ir vê-lo; rogo-te que me dês por escusado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν Ζεύγη βοῶν ἠγόρασα πέντε καὶ πορεύομαι δοκιμάσαι αὐτά ἐρωτῶ σε ἔχε με παρῃτημένον
verses.transliteration: Kai heteros eipen Zeugē boōn ēgorasa pente kai poreuomai dokimasai auta erōtō se eche me parētēmenon
verses.literal: Another said I have bought five yoke of oxen and I am going to try them out Please . . . excuse me
verses.literalPt: Comprei cinco juntas de bois, disse outro, e vou experimentá-las; rogo-te que me dês por escusado.

verses.original: Καὶ ἕτερος εἶπεν Γυναῖκα ἔγημα καὶ διὰ τοῦτο οὐ δύναμαι ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai heteros eipen Gynaika egēma kai dia touto ou dynamai elthein
verses.literal: Still another said I have married a wife so . . . I cannot come
verses.literalPt: Casei-me, disse outro ainda e por isso não posso ir.

verses.original: Καὶ παραγενόμενος ὁ δοῦλος ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα τότε ὀργισθεὶς ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης εἶπεν τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἔξελθε ταχέως εἰς τὰς πλατείας καὶ ῥύμας τῆς πόλεως καὶ τοὺς πτωχοὺς καὶ ἀναπείρους καὶ τυφλοὺς καὶ χωλοὺς εἰσάγαγε ὧδε
verses.transliteration: Kai paragenomenos ho doulos apēngeilen tō kyriō autou tauta tote orgistheis ho oikodespotēs eipen tō doulō autou Exelthe tacheōs eis tas plateias kai rhymas tēs poleōs kai tous ptōchous kai anapeirous kai typhlous kai chōlous eisagage hōde
verses.literal: The servant returned and reported all this to his master Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city and bring in . . . the poor the crippled the blind and the lame
verses.literalPt: O servo voltou e contou isso ao seu senhor. Então, irado, o dono da casa disse ao seu servo: Sai depressa para as ruas e becos da cidade e traze para aqui os pobres, os aleijados, os cegos e os coxos.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ δοῦλος Κύριε γέγονεν ὃ ἐπέταξας καὶ ἔτι τόπος ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen ho doulos Kyrie gegonen ho epetaxas kai eti topos estin
verses.literal: Sir the servant replied what you ordered has been done and there is still room
verses.literalPt: Disse o servo: Senhor, feito está o que ordenaste, e ainda há lugar.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος πρὸς τὸν δοῦλον Ἔξελθε εἰς τὰς ὁδοὺς καὶ φραγμοὺς καὶ ἀνάγκασον εἰσελθεῖν ἵνα γεμισθῇ μου ὁ οἶκος
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen ho kyrios pros ton doulon Exelthe eis tas hodous kai phragmous kai anankason eiselthein hina gemisthē mou ho oikos
verses.literal: So the master told . . . his servant Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in so that my house will be full
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe o senhor: Sai pelos caminhos e atalhos e obriga a todos a entrar, para que se encha minha casa;

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐκείνων τῶν κεκλημένων γεύσεταί μου τοῦ δείπνου
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin hoti oudeis tōn andrōn ekeinōn tōn keklēmenōn geusetai mou tou deipnou
verses.literal: For I tell you not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet
verses.literalPt: porque vos declaro que nenhum daqueles homens que foram convidados provará a minha ceia.

verses.original: Συνεπορεύοντο δὲ αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί καὶ στραφεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Syneporeuonto de autō ochloi polloi kai strapheis eipen pros autous
verses.literal: Now large crowds were traveling with Jesus and He turned and said to them
verses.literalPt: Uma grande multidão o acompanhava, e, virando-se Jesus para ela, lhe disse:

verses.original: Εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρός με καὶ οὐ μισεῖ τὸν πατέρα ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τὰς ἀδελφάς ἔτι τε καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν ἑαυτοῦ οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής
verses.transliteration: Ei tis erchetai pros me kai ou misei ton patera heautou kai tēn mētera kai tēn gynaika kai ta tekna kai tous adelphous kai tas adelphas eti te kai tēn psychēn heautou ou dynatai einai mou mathētēs
verses.literal: If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters yes even his own life he cannot be My disciple
verses.literalPt: Se alguém vem a mim e não aborrece a seu pai, e mãe, e mulher, e filhos, e irmãos, e irmãs, e ainda a sua própria vida, não pode ser meu discípulo.

verses.original: ὅστις οὐ βαστάζει τὸν σταυρὸν ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἔρχεται ὀπίσω μου οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής
verses.transliteration: hostis ou bastazei ton stauron heautou kai erchetai opisō mou ou dynatai einai mou mathētēs
verses.literal: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow . . . Me cannot be My disciple
verses.literalPt: Quem não carrega a sua cruz e não me segue não pode ser meu discípulo.

verses.original: Τίς γὰρ ἐξ ὑμῶν θέλων πύργον οἰκοδομῆσαι οὐχὶ πρῶτον καθίσας ψηφίζει τὴν δαπάνην εἰ ἔχει εἰς ἀπαρτισμόν
verses.transliteration: Tis gar ex hymōn thelōn pyrgon oikodomēsai ouchi prōton kathisas psēphizei tēn dapanēn ei echei eis apartismon
verses.literal: Which of you wishing to build a tower does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it
verses.literalPt: Pois qual de vós, querendo edificar uma torre, não se assenta primeiro a calcular a despesa, para ver se tem com que a acabar?

verses.original: ἵνα μή ποτε θέντος αὐτοῦ θεμέλιον καὶ μὴ ἰσχύοντος ἐκτελέσαι πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντες ἄρξωνται αὐτῷ ἐμπαίζειν
verses.transliteration: hina mē pote thentos autou themelion kai mē ischyontos ektelesai pantes hoi theōrountes arxōntai autō empaizein
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . . . . if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work everyone who sees it will ridicule him
verses.literalPt: Para não suceder que, tendo lançado os alicerces e não a podendo acabar, todos os que a virem comecem a zombar dele,

verses.original: λέγοντες ὅτι Οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἤρξατο οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσεν ἐκτελέσαι
verses.transliteration: legontes hoti Houtos ho anthrōpos ērxato oikodomein kai ouk ischysen ektelesai
verses.literal: saying This man could not finish what he started to build
verses.literalPt: dizendo: Este homem começou a edificar e não pôde acabar.

verses.original: Ἢ τίς βασιλεὺς πορευόμενος ἑτέρῳ βασιλεῖ συμβαλεῖν εἰς πόλεμον οὐχὶ καθίσας πρῶτον βουλεύσεται εἰ δυνατός ἐστιν ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν ὑπαντῆσαι τῷ μετὰ εἴκοσι χιλιάδων ἐρχομένῳ ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ē tis basileus poreuomenos heterō basilei symbalein eis polemon ouchi kathisas prōton bouleusetai ei dynatos estin en deka chiliasin hypantēsai tō meta eikosi chiliadōn erchomenō ep’ auton
verses.literal: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down . . . and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand
verses.literalPt: Ou qual é o rei que, indo entrar em guerra contra outro rei, não se assenta primeiro e consulta se, com dez mil homens, poderá enfrentar o que vem contra ele com vinte mil?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ μή¦γε ἔτι αὐτοῦ πόρρω ὄντος πρεσβείαν ἀποστείλας ἐρωτᾷ τὰ πρὸς εἰρήνην
verses.transliteration: ei de mē¦ge eti autou porrō ontos presbeian aposteilas erōta ta pros eirēnēn
verses.literal: And if he is unable he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off to ask for terms of peace
verses.literalPt: Se não, enquanto o outro ainda está longe, envia-lhe uma embaixada, pedindo-lhe condições de paz.

verses.original: Οὕτως οὖν πᾶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ὃς οὐκ ἀποτάσσεται πᾶσιν τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ὑπάρχουσιν οὐ δύναται εἶναί μου μαθητής
verses.transliteration: Houtōs oun pas ex hymōn hos ouk apotassetai pasin tois heautou hyparchousin ou dynatai einai mou mathētēs
verses.literal: In the same way . . . any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, todo aquele que, dentre vós, não renuncia a tudo o que possui não pode ser meu discípulo.

verses.original: Καλὸν οὖν τὸ ἅλας ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ ἐν τίνι ἀρτυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Kalon oun to halas ean de kai to halas mōranthē en tini artythēsetai
verses.literal: Salt is good but if the salt loses its savor with what will it be seasoned
verses.literalPt: O sal, na verdade, é bom; mas, se o sal se tiver tornado insípido, como se poderá restaurar-lhe o sabor?

verses.original: οὔτε εἰς γῆν οὔτε εἰς κοπρίαν εὔθετόν ἐστιν ἔξω βάλλουσιν αὐτό Ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω
verses.transliteration: oute eis gēn oute eis koprian eutheton estin exō ballousin auto Ho echōn ōta akouein akouetō
verses.literal: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile and it is thrown out He who has ears to hear let him hear
verses.literalPt: Não é mais útil nem para a terra nem para o estrume; é lançado fora. Quem tem ouvidos para ouvir, ouça.
